findings.title: Starter adoption rewrites unrelated workspace member names
findings.why_it_matters: Initializing from a custom starter can silently rename unrelated members and leave the resulting workspace unable to find its intended dependencies. For example, when the starter name is `sample`, this global substring replacement changes both an `edit: - sample` entry and a `discover: - sample-extra` entry. Rewrite only the exact self-name scalar in the edit list using the engine's YAML semantics so other names, quoted values, and comments are preserved.
findings.suggested_fix: Parse the workspace manifest using the engine's existing YAML representation, replace only edit-list entries whose complete scalar value equals the old repository name, and test prefix-sharing and quoted names.

findings.title: Verification harnesses search the retired socket directory
findings.why_it_matters: Client compatibility, model-turn, and other checks using the shared fixture time out before reaching their checks on a fresh home, even when the engine starts correctly. The fixture creates an empty HOME but searches only `.arsumbris`, whereas the engine selects `.2brain` when neither state directory exists; the mutation-fixture capture and rollback rehearsal repeat the same stale lookup. Deriving the socket using the engine's current state-directory selection restores these verification paths and avoids another rebrand-dependent copy.
findings.suggested_fix: Isolate 2BRAIN_HOME inside each temporary fixture and derive or query the daemon socket from that state root, updating the shared shell harness and the independent Python capture and rehearsal scripts.

findings.title: Client verification builds and looks in different directories
findings.why_it_matters: A fresh checkout cannot run the client matrix with its documented engine override: it builds the adapter when the default executable is missing, but Cargo places the executable in the monorepo's shared `.cargo-target`, while the script continues looking in `tb-mcp-rs/target`. Other verification and fixture scripts also default to the old per-crate target directories, forcing operators to discover and override both binary paths manually. Resolve default binaries from the shared target directory so a successful build is actually used.
findings.suggested_fix: Set verification script defaults from the repository root's `.cargo-target/{debug,release}` for both `au` and `2brain`, and use the same resolved path after client-matrix builds the adapter.
